input_facts.text:
The December 20, 2022 BOJ statement retains minus 0.1% for Policy-Rate Balances and a target around zero for 10-year JGB yields.
The permitted 10-year yield fluctuation range expands from about plus/minus 0.25 percentage point to plus/minus 0.5 percentage point. The Bank offers daily fixed-rate purchases at 0.5%, unless bids are highly unlikely.
The announced monthly JGB purchases rise from 7.3 trillion yen to about 9 trillion yen. The statement describes the change as improving market functioning while maintaining accommodation.

adjudication_excerpt.text: The upper edge rises 25 basis points; the full interval widens from 50 to 100 basis points. Neither is a 50-basis-point short-rate hike or a new 0.5% central target. Announced purchases are about 1.7 trillion yen higher per month, not an observed purchase total. A stated objective does not establish realized effects, exchange-rate direction or a trade. No later policy change is supplied.

question_en: Compare the short-rate setting, long-rate target and permitted range, quantify the changes in the range and monthly purchase plan, and state what the announcement establishes about subsequent outcomes.

expected_properties.check: The upper edge of the permitted 10-year yield fluctuation range rises 25 basis points and the full interval widens from 50 to 100 basis points, from about plus/minus 0.25 percentage point to plus/minus 0.5 percentage point.

The band change is neither a 50-basis-point short-rate hike nor a new 0.5% central target: the Policy-Rate Balances rate remains minus 0.1%, the 10-year yield target remains around zero, and 0.5% is the widened upper edge and the daily fixed-rate purchase offer rate.
Announced monthly JGB purchases rise from 7.3 trillion yen to about 9 trillion yen, about 1.7 trillion yen higher per month; this is an announced purchase plan, not an observed purchase total.
The stated objective of improving market functioning while maintaining accommodation does not establish realized effects, exchange-rate direction or a trade, and no later policy change is supplied.

known_failure_modes: Describing the band change as a 50-basis-point short-rate hike or a new 0.5% central target instead of an upper edge 25 basis points higher with the full interval widening from 50 to 100 basis points.

Confusing basis points with percentage points across the widened range, or reading the retained minus 0.1% Policy-Rate Balances setting or the around-zero 10-year yield target as changed by the band move.
Presenting the announced monthly purchase plan (7.3 trillion yen rising to about 9 trillion yen) as an observed purchase total rather than a plan about 1.7 trillion yen higher per month.
Treating the stated objective as establishing realized effects, an exchange-rate direction or a trade, or supplying a later policy change that the announcement does not contain.
